channel.title: The OC Pack: Orange County Dog & Pet Parents
channel.description: The OC Pack is the weekly podcast for Orange County pet parents: dog-friendly beaches, trails and patios, vet-bill saving strategies, training and health tips, and the local intel that makes life with your pet happier and more affordable. Hosted by Alex and Jordan. New episode every Thursday.
channel.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi
channel.itunes:summary: The OC Pack is the weekly podcast for Orange County pet parents: dog-friendly beaches, trails and patios, vet-bill saving strategies, training and health tips, and the local intel that makes life with your pet happier and more affordable. Hosted by Alex and Jordan. New episode every Thursday.

item.title: Episode 1: The OC Pet Parent Starter Pack
item.description: The OC dog beach and trail guide, a pet adoption event in Irvine, the vet-bill trick that saves real money, and the two-minute safety check every trail dog needs.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: The OC Pack — Episode 2: The Pull-Free Walk
item.description: Your walk only moves when the leash is loose — Alex and Jordan teach the one rule that ends pulling for good, plus OC leash law, the gear that actually helps, and how to earn off-leash freedom at Huntington Dog Beach. Also in this episode: Irvine Animal Care Center's Puppy Wellness Program (a $50 training credit — check whether you qualify) and what to do when your dog lunges at other dogs on walks.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: The OC Pack — Episode 3: The Vet Bill Playbook
item.description: The Vet Bill Playbook: Alex and Jordan walk through seven plays for keeping vet costs down — asking for written estimates and itemized bills, knowing when waiting is safe, California's free-written-prescription right, getting second estimates on big-ticket care, knowing your care tiers (regular vet, urgent care, 24-hour ER), low-cost nonprofit clinics, and planning for big bills before the emergency. Also in this episode: a Golden State Humane Society spotlight with OC low-cost spay/neuter resources, and Ask the Pack answers whether it's rude to ask your vet for a cheaper option. Takeaway: slow down the yes.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: The OC Pack — Episode 4: The Five-Minute Recall
item.description: A slipped leash at Huntington Dog Beach is every OC dog parent's nightmare — Alex and Jordan build the recall that brings your dog back anyway: one protected cue word, recall-only jackpot treats, and the five-minute daily drill that climbs from a quiet room to a thirty-foot long line at the park. Also in this episode: where to practice recall legally in Orange County (Irvine Central Bark and Orange Dog Park at Yorba Park), the collar-grab game, the supercharged emergency recall word you almost never spend, and Ask the Pack answers why your dog recalls perfectly at home and ignores you at the dog park. Takeaway: five minutes a day — make the word the best news your dog ever hears.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: The OC Pack — Episode 5: Halloween Night: The Doorbell Marathon
item.description: Halloween lands on a Saturday this year, so there is no school-night mercy: the front door opens dozens of times and the pet plan has to be built before sundown. Alex and Jordan run the doorbell marathon plan: the quiet room, the driveway candy station that keeps the doorbell silent, the pre-week ID check on collar tags and microchip phone numbers, and the complete candy rules (chocolate, xylitol, raisins, wrappers). Also in this episode: costume try-ons without the stress, the real walk done early Saturday afternoon, the Sunday-morning candy sweep, and Ask the Pack answers whether the friendliest dog in the neighborhood really has to miss the party. Takeaway: set the quiet room, lock the candy up high, and check the tag, all before Saturday at sundown.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: The OC Pack — Episode 6: Three Acres of Freedom: Inside Irvine Central Bark
item.description: Three acres of off-leash freedom in the middle of Irvine: inside Central Bark, with its separate runs for small and large dogs and the Wednesday closure rule every regular plans around. We tour the park, share the ground rules that keep it friendly, and flag the full-day closure on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi
